sentence: He won't be able to complete the project on his own.
synonym: He can't finish the project by himself
synonymNote: 意思相同，表示他独自无法完成这个项目

distractors.word: He doesn't want to finish the project alone
distractors.note: 表示不想做，而非没有能力做，意思不同

distractors.word: He will complete the project on his own
distractors.note: 意思相反，表示他能独自完成

distractors.word: He needs someone to start the project
distractors.note: 表示开始项目，而非完成项目，意思不同
